sum: This study presents a three-dimensional S-wave velocity model of the crust across the Sumatran forearc–back-arc system in Indonesia using ambient noise tomography. By cross-correlating continuous ambient seismic noise, the authors extract empirical Green's functions (primarily Rayleigh waves) to map shear-wave velocity variations. The resulting model reveals prominent crustal heterogeneities, highlighting low-velocity zones associated with the Sumatran Fault Zone, active volcanic arcs, and sedimentary basins, alongside high-velocity anomalies in the forearc and stable blocks. These findings provide crucial insights into the subduction dynamics, magma plumbing systems, and crustal deformation of the active Sumatran convergent margin.
本研究利用背景噪声断层成像技术，构建了印度尼西亚苏门答腊弧前-弧后系统的高分辨率三维地壳S波速度模型。通过对连续背景噪声数据进行互相关处理，提取了经验格林函数（主要是瑞雷面波），并反演获得了剪切波速度结构。结果揭示了显著的地壳非均匀性，包括与苏门答腊断裂带、活动火山弧及沉积盆地相关的低速异常，以及弧……

sum: This study investigates the dynamics of the Mohns and Knipovich mid-ocean ridges in the Arctic Ocean using innovative thermo-mechanical numerical models. By incorporating regional geodynamic features, such as asymmetric half-spreading rates, non-linear ridge geometry, ridge migration, and pre-existing mantle heterogeneity, the models successfully reproduce along-axis thermal variations and across-axis asymmetries observed at the ridge intersection. The results demonstrate that these intrinsic parameters strongly influence partial melting, magma distribution, and plate reorganization, challenging the traditional view of symmetric seafloor spreading and highlighting the critical role of mantle heterogeneity in mid-ocean ridge evolution.
本研究利用热-机械数值模拟探讨了北冰洋洋中脊的动力学。模型结合非对称扩张率、非线性脊几何、脊迁移及地幔非均匀性，成功重现了观测到的轴向温度变化和跨轴非对称性。结果表明，这些参数显著影响部分熔融、岩浆分布和板块重组，挑战了对称海底扩张的传统观点，强调了地幔非均匀性在洋中脊演化中的关键作用。

t: Thermo-mechanical numerical modeling incorporating asymmetric spreading rates, non-linear ridge geometry, ridge migration, and pre-existing mantle heterogeneity.

sum: The authors present a micro-continuum computational fluid dynamics (CFD) model to simulate cohesive sediment gravity flows (SGFs) across mudslide, mudflow, and turbidity current regimes. By incorporating independent measurements of sediment solid fraction and rheological yield stress, the model successfully captures the complex viscoplastic behavior of clay-rich matrices (e.g., smectite and kaolinite). It reproduces four distinct flow regimes observed in lock-exchange experiments: low-density turbidity currents, high-density turbidity currents, mudflows, and mudslides. Validated against experimental data on flow morphology, speed, and runout distance, this model provides a predictive framework for understanding how intrinsic properties (particle size, density, rheology) and extrinsic factors (topography, solid fraction) control self-sustaining cohesive SGFs.

sum: This study presents the design, implementation, and initial performance of the first regional-scale Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) seismic monitoring network in northeastern Italy, integrated into the operational framework of the Seismological Research Center of OGS. Utilizing dark fiber segments of a public telecommunication network and multiple DAS units, the system spans several hundred kilometers, generating tens of thousands of virtual channels. The authors establish an end-to-end workflow for continuous acquisition, data format conversion, metadata handling, and real-time streaming via SeedLink. Case studies demonstrate the network's capability to record local and teleseismic earthquakes, characterize spatial ambient noise, and improve earthquake location when integrated with conventional seismic stations. This work demonstrates the feasibility of large-scale operational DAS for regional seismic monitoring, while highlighting ongoing challenges in data volume, directional sensitivity, and channel localization.

sum: This study investigates the complexity of earthquake cycles using 3D rate-and-state friction simulations on a single dipping fault. The authors systematically analyze how physical parameters—such as the ratio of seismogenic width to nucleation length ($W'$), fault dip, and down-dip/lateral frictional transitions—and numerical factors like meshing choices control the transition from periodic to irregular stick-slip behavior. They find that while increasing $W'$ promotes irregular cycles, fault dip and frictional heterogeneities can independently induce similar transitions and compete with $W'$. Crucially, the study demonstrates that subtle meshing choices can artificially force periodic solutions, highlighting the high sensitivity of physics-based earthquake simulations to both physical and numerical assumptions.
本研究利用单倾斜断层上的三维速率-状态摩擦模拟，探讨了地震周期的复杂性。作者系统分析了物理参数（如震源区宽度与成核长度之比 $W'$、断层倾角、沿倾向和走向的摩擦过渡带）以及数值因素（如网格划分）对周期性向非周期性/无序地震周期过渡的控制作用。结果表明，增加 $W'$ 会促进无序周期，而断层倾角和摩……

Synthetic numerical experiments systematically varying fault dip, frictional transitions, and grid meshing parameters.

sum: This software and data repository accompanies the study 'Seismic Evidence for Increasing Unfrozen Pore Water Heterogeneity from Roadside to Coastal Arctic Tundra.' It provides processed data products and Jupyter notebooks to reproduce MASW (Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves) shear-wave velocity (Vs) profiles, temperature- and laboratory-informed reference constraints, joint porosity inversion outputs, and final water saturation (Sw) profiles. By comparing Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and conventional geophone arrays, the underlying research characterizes the spatial heterogeneity of unfrozen pore water in Arctic tundra permafrost. The repository serves as an open-science tool for reproducible environmental seismology and cryosphere characterization.

sum: This study deploys a dense array of 309 short-period nodal seismometers across the middle segment of the Longriba fault zone (LRBFZ) in the eastern Tibetan Plateau. Using ambient noise tomography, the authors construct a high-resolution 3D isotropic shear-wave velocity (VS) and azimuthal anisotropy model of the shallow crust (0–12 km). The isotropic model reveals a prominent velocity contrast across the fault and a localized low-velocity anomaly at the intersection of the LRBFZ and the Aba South fault, indicating intense fracturing and fluid enrichment. Azimuthal anisotropy shows NWW-SEE fast directions aligned with regional extrusion-driven stress, with local rotations near the fault linkage zone. This provides key constraints on fault zone heterogeneity and deformation.
本研究在青藏高原东缘龙日坝断裂带中段部署了309台短周期节点地震仪。利用背景噪声断层成像方法，构建了浅地壳（0-12 km）高分辨率三维各向同性剪切波速度（VS）和方位各向异性模型。结果显示，断裂带两侧存在显著的速度对比，且在龙日坝断裂与阿坝南断裂交汇处存在显著的低速异常，指示了强烈的岩石破裂和流体……

sum: This study evaluates the potential of the IceCube Upgrade, deployed in the 2025-26 polar season, to probe the Earth's interior using atmospheric neutrino oscillations. By reducing the detector's energy threshold and improving multi-GeV neutrino reconstruction, the upgrade enhances sensitivity to Earth matter effects. The authors estimate the detector's capability to verify the non-homogeneous density distribution of the Earth, estimate its total mass, and measure correlated layer densities of the Preliminary Reference Earth Model (PREM). This neutrino-based tomography provides an independent, complementary method to traditional seismic and gravitational measurements, incorporating constraints from Earth's mass and moment of inertia.
本研究评估了冰立方升级版利用大气中微子振荡探测地球内部结构的能力。通过提高多GeV中微子重建精度，该升级增强了对地球物质效应的敏感性。研究估算了探测器验证地球非均匀密度分布、估算总质量及测量PREM模型各层密度的能力。这种中微子成像方法为传统地震和重力测量提供了独立且互补的约束。

sum: This study presents a 10,000-year synthetic earthquake catalog for the Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT) using the physics-based simulator RSQSim, incorporating geodetic models of geometry and slip rate. The simulated catalog successfully reproduces key characteristics of historical seismicity. A major finding is that geodetically inferred low-coupling zones consistently act as barriers to rupture propagation, limiting the maximum earthquake magnitude to Mw 8.9. Integrating this synthetic catalog into a probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) for Nepal reveals significant differences in Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) compared to conventional PSHA models, with differences ranging from +30% to -70% depending on the probability of exceedance. This work demonstrates that physics-based earthquake simulations provide a valuable, physically consistent complement to traditional hazard assessment methods in regions with limited historical records.

sum: This study investigates deep slab deformation and rupture mechanisms in the Tonga subduction zone using relative earthquake relocation and focal mechanism clustering. Utilizing regional arrival times from land and ocean-bottom seismometers alongside teleseismic phases, the authors relocate earthquakes via hypocentroidal decomposition and perform K-means clustering on GCMT solutions. The results reveal that deep earthquakes align along a dense, narrow (<3 km) seismic plane coplanar with steeply dipping nodal planes at the upper boundary of the slab. This seismicity is interpreted as active fault zones accommodating the downward motion of the Tonga slab relative to stagnant material to the west. The findings suggest these fault zones represent planes of recurrent thermal shear runaway within the subducted oceanic crust, providing key insights into deep earthquake physical mechanisms.

sum: This study characterizes the 3D structure of the Los Angeles Basin and its underlying Moho using a dense seismic deployment of 273 nodes from Fall 2022. To overcome phase incoherency in sparse array configurations, the authors developed a novel algorithm to identify P-to-S conversions and multiple phases in receiver functions, representing sediment-basement, intrasedimentary, and Moho interfaces. By integrating gravity measurements, they jointly modeled the multi-layer crustal structure. The results reveal a narrow, oblong basin reaching a maximum depth of approximately 10 km. Under the assumption of isostatic equilibrium, the underlying Moho is found to be uplifted by up to 45% compared to the surrounding crust, providing critical constraints for seismic hazard assessment and tectonic models of Southern California.

sum: This study addresses the paradox of how Large Low Velocity Provinces (LLVPs) survive mantle convection despite high temperatures and water content that typically reduce rheological strength. Through high-pressure experiments, the authors demonstrate that water incorporation significantly accelerates the grain growth (coarsening) of bridgmanite, the dominant lower mantle mineral. The resulting larger grain size in water-rich LLVPs increases their viscosity by approximately 1.4 orders of magnitude compared to the surrounding mantle. This grain-size hardening effect overcomes the weakening effects of temperature and hydration, providing a robust physical mechanism for the long-term stability and longevity of LLVPs at the core-mantle boundary.

sum: This study presents the first 1D shear-wave velocity (Vs) model down to approximately 1 km depth for Pantelleria Island, Italy's southernmost active volcanic system. Using ambient seismic noise recordings from a temporary seismic network integrated with permanent INGV stations, the authors applied seismic array techniques to retrieve the velocity structure. The resulting Vs model is geologically interpreted using stratigraphic data from deep wells and other geophysical/geological surveys. This model provides crucial constraints on the shallow crustal structure of Pantelleria, enhancing our understanding of its volcanic-hydrothermal system, improving local earthquake localization, and supporting future geothermal resource exploration.

sum: This study revisits the spatio-temporal variations of the Gutenberg–Richter b-value in the Groningen gas field, Europe's largest onshore reservoir. By integrating the original Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute (RNMI) dataset with an enhanced earthquake catalogue that utilizes machine learning to identify 660 new events, the authors evaluate the consistency of previously proposed b-value patterns and hypotheses. The combined catalogue better captures recent trends associated with reduced gas extraction rates and a southward shift in production. The results confirm persistent low-b regions in the north and a trend toward spatial homogeneity. Furthermore, the study demonstrates that the continued decrease in b-value compensates for the overall reduction in seismic activity, maintaining a significant probability for larger induced events. This work highlights the value of machine-learning-enhanced catalogs for robust seismic hazard assessment in producing reservoirs.

sum: This paper introduces the Marlinks-NS DAS dataset, a publicly available benchmark designed for submarine cable protection using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS). The dataset consists of 74,771 labeled data instances extracted from ten days of continuous recording along a 2,554-meter segment of a buried fiber-optic cable in the North Sea. It integrates spectral-energy features from 250 sensing channels with AIS-derived vessel information. The authors define two key machine-learning tasks: vessel detection and vessel-to-cable distance estimation. By providing processed HDF5 data, documentation, and example code, this work establishes a reproducible framework to develop and evaluate acoustic-based vessel monitoring and localization algorithms, addressing critical security and maintenance needs for submarine infrastructure.

sum: This study investigates the cumulative damage and strength degradation of coal and rock masses subjected to strong mining tremors. Using seismic-wave forward modeling, the authors show that high-frequency mining tremors induce intermediate strain-rate disturbances in the near-field. To simulate these effects, they develop a Dynamic Cyclic Damage Contact Model (DCDCM) that incorporates strain-rate strengthening and fatigue damage by progressively reducing the contact bond radius. Numerical experiments demonstrate that higher cyclic stress amplitudes and longer durations accelerate fatigue damage. Interestingly, higher loading rates reduce initial single-cycle damage due to strain-rate effects but accelerate cumulative deterioration. Compressive strength is identified as the most sensitive indicator of degradation.
本文研究强矿震下煤岩体的累积损伤与强度退化。正演表明高频强矿震在近场诱发中等应变率扰动。为此开发了动态循环损伤接触模型（DCDCM），通过减小粘结半径表征疲劳并考虑应变率强化。模拟表明，高应力幅值和长持续时间加剧疲劳；高加载率虽减少单次初始损伤，但加速累积劣化。该模型为评估岩体动力损伤提供了新框架。

sum: This study investigates the temperature-dependent frictional properties of oceanic basalt and pelagic sediments subducting at the Japan Trench. Through laboratory friction experiments under hydrothermal conditions, the authors characterize the transition from velocity-strengthening to velocity-weakening behavior as temperature increases. These experimental results provide critical constraints on the depth limits of seismogenic locking and the potential for shallow earthquake rupture or slow slip events along the plate boundary megathrust.

sum: This study investigates the geodynamic effects of slab folding on magma production in the Sumatra subduction zone. Using the open-source ASPECT mantle convection code, the authors perform numerical simulations that successfully reproduce the observed slab folding geometries in the region. The modeling demonstrates how the deformation and folding of the subducting slab influence local thermal structures, mantle flow, and dehydration processes, thereby controlling the spatial and temporal distribution of magma generation. This work provides key insights into the deep physical mechanisms driving arc volcanism in Sumatra.

sum: This study constructs a high-resolution broadband Lg-wave attenuation model for the Carpathian-Pannonian Region to investigate the mechanisms of intraplate magmatism. Strong Lg attenuation is observed in late-Cenozoic magmatic provinces. In the western Pannonian Basin, high attenuation correlates with steep sub-lithospheric topography (lithospheric cliffs), suggesting that shear-driven asthenospheric upwelling beneath the Eastern Alps and European Platform triggers crustal partial melting and basaltic volcanism. In the southeastern Carpathians, enhanced attenuation is linked to mantle flow induced by slab rollback, promoting lithospheric reworking, fluid release, and crustal melting. These findings provide critical constraints on the thermal structure and geodynamics of intraplate volcanism.

sum: This study presents a workflow to optimize the Measurement, Monitoring, and Verification (MMV) program for a prospective CO2 injection test site near Trüllikon, Switzerland. By integrating fault identification, fluid pressure, and seismic risk modeling, the authors establish MMV performance targets. The optimization shows that adding seven broadband stations improves the magnitude of completeness from ML 0.9 to ML 0.0 and enhances location resolution to 50–100 m. Additionally, a temporary downhole fiber-optic deployment is used to quantify noise attenuation with depth, showing a 10- to 30-fold improvement. This risk-embedded design workflow serves as a template for future geological carbon storage operations.

sum: The paper introduces SeismoStats, an open-source, well-documented Python package designed to streamline statistical seismology workflows. It provides tools for downloading, manipulating, and visualizing earthquake catalogs. Key functionalities include estimating the Gutenberg–Richter law parameters (a- and b-values) and determining the magnitude of completeness ($M_c$). SeismoStats aims to establish a collaborative, community-driven foundation for statistical seismology, encouraging contributions to expand its capabilities for seismic hazard assessment and catalog analysis.

sum: This study presents a deep learning-based denoising workflow for raw distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) vertical seismic profiling (VSP) data using the Noise2Noise (N2N) framework. Applied to vibroseis data from Gyeongju, South Korea, the method denoises raw records directly before correlation with the vibroseis sweep, preserving processing flexibility. By exploiting a turnaround fibre-optic configuration, the authors construct training pairs with identical signals but independent noise by cutting and flipping traces around the midpoint. This self-supervised approach trains site-specific models directly on field data without requiring clean labels. Evaluations show that this pre-correlation N2N approach outperforms self-supervised methods like Noise2Void and conventional techniques like stacking and band-pass filtering in signal-to-noise ratio and amplitude preservation.
本研究提出一种基于Noise2Noise自监督深度学习的原始DAS-VSP数据去噪方法。该方法在可控震源互相关前直接对原始数据去噪，保留了处理灵活性。利用回折光纤的对称性，通过裁剪和翻转波形构建具有相同信号但独立噪声的训练对，实现了无需干净标签的现场数据直接训练。结果表明，该方法在信噪比提升上优于N……

sum: This study develops a regionally calibrated local magnitude (ML) scale for the Kiskatinaw Seismic Monitoring and Mitigation Area (KSMMA) in British Columbia, Canada, to address misestimations of shallow, near-source induced earthquakes. Using continuous 2020 seismic data from 23 stations, the authors reprocessed waveforms and uniformly measured Wood-Anderson amplitudes. Earthquakes were detected using the PALM algorithm and located with HYPOINVERSE-2000 and hypoDD. Through generalized linear inversion, they derived station corrections and attenuation coefficients. The resulting dataset of 4,043 earthquakes (-0.53 <= ML <= 3.04) shows that the new scale systematically yields magnitudes ~0.3 units lower than previous regional scales. This calibration reduces scatter in station residuals, providing more reliable magnitude estimates for regulatory compliance and seismic hazard assessment.
针对加拿大KSMMA地区浅源诱发地震震级偏差，本研究开发了区域校准的地方震级（ML）标度。利用2020年23个台站数据，通过PALM算法检测并定位了4043个地震。采用广义线性反演获得台站校正与衰减系数。结果显示新标度测定震级平均低约0.3，显著降低了残差，为诱发地震监管提供了更可靠的评估工具。

t: Generalized linear inversion of Wood-Anderson amplitudes from vertical-component simulated seismograms, combined with PALM detection and double-difference relocation.
基于模拟WA振幅的广义线性反演，结合PALM检测与双差定位技术。
Continuous 2020 seismic waveforms from 23 stations (EON-ROSE and GSC-BCOGC networks) in the Kiskatinaw Seismic Monitoring and Mitigation Area, Canada.

A new local magnitude scale yielding magnitudes ~0.3 units lower on average than previous scales, reducing scatter in event-station residuals for 4,043 earthquakes.

sum: This study investigates the frictional behavior of mica-schist gouge from the East Anatolian Fault under hydrothermal conditions. Through triaxial deformation experiments and seismic cycle simulations, the authors show that mica schist exhibits potentially unstable velocity-weakening behavior between 300°C and 400°C. This temperature-dependent friction promotes depth-confined earthquakes while allowing shallow aseismic creep. The findings successfully explain the rupture characteristics of the 2020 Mw 6.8 Elazığ earthquake and the northern rupture arrest of the 2023 Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş earthquake, demonstrating how lithological and thermal structures control fault segmentation and rupture dynamics.
本研究通过三轴变形实验和数值模拟，探讨了东安纳托利亚断层云母片岩在热液条件下的摩擦行为。结果表明，云母片岩在300°-400°C表现出潜在不稳定的速度弱化，促进深度局限型地震并允许浅部无震蠕滑。该摩擦特性解释了2020年埃拉泽地震及2023年卡赫拉曼马拉什地震北端破裂终止特征，揭示了热与岩石结构对断……

Mica schist exhibits unstable velocity-weakening between 300° and 400°C, explaining shallow aseismic creep and depth-confined ruptures like the 2020 Elazığ earthquake.

展示了岩石学与热结构的相互作用如何控制断层分段、浅部蠕滑和破裂终止。

Numerical simulation of seismic cycles using a physical model of rock friction and realistic thermal structures.

sum: This study investigates the geomorphic legacy of sequential earthquakes by analyzing the 2013 and 2022 events near Lushan, China. The authors quantify how the first earthquake preconditions hillslope stability for the second. They identify a dual effect: while regional landslide susceptibility decreased due to the evacuation of unstable materials, localized coseismic damage weakened other hillslopes, leading to their failure in 2022. These competing mechanisms define three distinct damage-recovery pathways of hillslope response. The findings demonstrate that hillslope response is fundamentally path-dependent, highlighting a prolonged 'hillslope memory' that must be integrated into future landslide hazard assessments and models of mountain belt landscape evolution.
本研究分析中国芦山2013和2022年两次地震，定量探讨了前次地震对后次滑坡的调控作用。研究发现第一场地震具有双重效应：清除不稳定物质降低了区域滑坡易发性，但局部同震损伤削弱了其他山坡导致其在2022年失稳。这些机制定义了三种损伤-恢复路径，表明山坡响应具有路径依赖性与长期“山坡记忆”，对防灾减灾有……

Landslide inventories and topographic data from the 2013 and 2022 earthquake sequence near Lushan, China.
中国四川芦山2013年和2022年地震序列的同震滑坡编目及地形数据。

sum: This paper investigates the critical role of sulfur in the mantle melting and magma ocean dynamics of Mercury. Under the planet's characteristically highly reducing conditions, the authors perform thermodynamic modeling and experimental petrology to evaluate how sulfur abundance affects the liquidus and solidus of mafic magmas. They find that sulfur significantly depresses melting temperatures, which in turn alters the crystallization sequence of the Mercurian magma ocean and influences the depth and degree of subsequent mantle melting. These results provide key insights into the thermochemical evolution of Mercury's interior and the origin of its surface volcanic plains.
本研究探讨了硫对水星极度还原条件下地幔熔融和岩浆洋动力学演化的关键影响。作者通过实验岩石学与热力学模拟，评估了硫含量对基性岩浆液相线和固相线温度的降低作用。研究表明，硫的加入显著降低了熔融温度，从而改变了水星岩浆洋的结晶路径，并影响了后续地幔熔融的深度与程度。该成果为理解水星内部的热化学演化及表面火……

t: Experimental petrology and thermodynamic modeling of sulfur-bearing silicate systems under highly reducing conditions.
在极度还原条件下对含硫硅酸盐系统进行实验岩石学研究与热力学模拟。
High-pressure, high-temperature experimental data on synthetic Mercurian mafic compositions and simulated crystallization paths.
合成水星基性成分的高温高压实验数据以及模拟的结晶路径。
Sulfur significantly depresses the melting temperatures of Mercurian magmas, altering magma ocean crystallization and mantle melting depths.
硫显著降低了水星岩浆的熔融温度，改变了岩浆洋结晶路径和地幔熔融深度。
Uncertainties in thermodynamic parameters at extreme reducing conditions and simplified volatile chemistry.
极端还原条件下的热力学参数存在不确定性，且简化了挥发分化学成分。

首次系统评估了硫对水星还原性地幔熔融行为和岩浆洋动力学的影响。

Modeled the crystallization sequence and dynamics of Mercury's early magma ocean in the presence of sulfur.

sum: This study explores the geodynamic and seismological relationship between heterogeneous stagnant slabs in the mantle transition zone and surface volcanic clustering. By analyzing deep mantle structures and geodynamic pathways, the paper demonstrates that the internal heterogeneity of stagnant slabs focuses the upwelling of recycled crustal materials. This localized transport mechanism directly controls the spatial distribution and clustering of volcanoes at the surface, providing a key link between deep subduction processes and surface magmatism.
本研究探讨了地幔过渡带中非均匀滞留板块与地表火山群聚之间的地球动力学和地震学联系。通过分析深部地幔结构与动力学路径，研究表明滞留板块内部的非均匀性聚集了循环地壳物质的上涌通道。这种局地输送机制直接控制了地表火山的空间分布与群聚特征，为深部俯冲过程与地表岩浆活动之间建立了关键联系。

结合地震层析成像与地幔过渡带过程的地球动力学模拟。

来自俯冲带的地震走时或波形数据，以及数值地球动力学模拟。
Heterogeneities within stagnant slabs focus the ascent of recycled crustal materials, leading to clustered surface volcanism.
滞留板块内部的非均匀性聚焦了循环地壳物质的上涌，导致地表火山群聚。
Resolution of deep mantle structures and simplified chemical assumptions in geodynamic models.

Linking deep stagnant slab internal heterogeneity directly to the spatial clustering of surface volcanoes.

揭示了地幔过渡带内部结构如何聚焦并引导局地地壳物质循环。

sum: This study investigates the propagation of precursory slow-slip fronts on the Whillans Ice Plain, Antarctica. By analyzing slip behavior, the authors show how these fronts navigate around localized high-friction 'sticky spots' before triggering faster, large-scale sliding. The work provides insights into the nucleation of seismic and aseismic slip in glacial environments, serving as an analog for tectonic fault mechanics.
本研究调查了南极威兰斯冰原上前驱慢滑移前锋的传播过程。通过分析滑移行为，作者展示了这些前锋在触发更大规模、更快速的滑动之前，是如何绕过局部的强摩擦“粘性点”传播的。该工作揭示了冰川环境中地震与无震滑移的成核机制，为构造断层力学提供了重要的类比。

sum: This paper presents a Bayesian probabilistic framework for landslide forecasting that explicitly accounts for epistemic uncertainty from incomplete inventories and variable measurements. Applying the method to a 22-year dataset of shallow landslides and daily rainfall in Campania, Italy, the authors calculate posterior landslide probabilities within Thiessen polygons using Bayes' theorem with uniform priors and Beta likelihoods. The results show that posterior probabilities increase progressively with rainfall (up to 0.2–0.8 at 70 mm) rather than exhibiting a sharp physical threshold. This gradual increase highlights the advantages of probabilistic over deterministic forecasting. The framework is generalizable to other triggers like earthquakes, offering a transparent, uncertainty-informed tool for early warning systems.
本文提出了一个考虑认知不确定性的贝叶斯滑坡概率预测框架。该方法将滑坡发生概率描述为分布而非单一值，以应对编目不完整和测量误差带来的不确定性。研究利用意大利坎帕尼亚地区22年的浅层滑坡和日降雨数据进行验证，采用贝叶斯定理（均匀先验和Beta似然）计算泰森多边形内的后验概率。结果表明，滑坡概率随降雨量增……

A 22-year dataset of shallow landslides and daily rainfall records from the Campania region in southern Italy, mapped to rain gauges using Thiessen polygons.

Posterior landslide probabilities increase progressively with rainfall, reaching 0.2 to 0.8 at a 70 mm threshold when accounting for uncertainty, without showing a sharp physical threshold.
后验滑坡概率随降雨量增加而渐进增加，在考虑不确定性时，70毫米降雨下的概率达到0.2至0.8，未出现明显的物理阈值。
The method is highly data-intensive and currently does not incorporate antecedent rainfall or geological conditioning factors across broader spatial and temporal scales.

sum: This paper addresses the thermodynamic paradox of island-arc volcanism at supposedly cool subduction zones. The authors propose a first-principles physics model tracking the conversion of gravitational energy (Eg) to heat during mantle convection. They estimate that thrust-faulting earthquakes in subduction zones release approximately 10 TW of gravitational energy—about 1000 times the seismic energy release and nearly a quarter of global heat flow. When converted to heat through irreversible processes, this energy is sufficient to power island-arc volcanism. Conversely, normal-faulting earthquakes at diverging boundaries result in a smaller gravitational energy gain of ~2 TW. This model introduces a new paradigm where seismicity plays an active role in plate tectonic energetics and mantle convection.
本文解决了俯冲带岛弧火山热源的经典悖论。作者提出首要物理原理模型，追踪地幔对流中重力能向热能的转化。研究估算，俯冲带逆冲地震释放约10 TW重力能，比地震波辐射能大近1000倍，占全球地热流近四分之一。该能量在不可逆对流中转化为热量，足以供给岛弧火山。该模型为地震在板块构造动力学中的作用提供了新范式……

t: First-principles physical modeling tracking the conversion of gravitational potential energy to heat during earthquake-induced mass transport in mantle convection.
追踪地幔对流中地震引起的物质运移过程中重力势能向热能转化的首要物理原理建模。
Global earthquake parameters and tectonic settings, specifically comparing thrust-faulting at subduction zones and normal-faulting at diverging boundaries.
全球地震参数和构造背景，特别是对比俯冲带的逆冲断层和离散边界的正断层。
Thrust earthquakes release ~10 TW of gravitational energy (1000x seismic energy), supplying island-arc volcanism, while normal earthquakes gain ~2 TW.
逆冲地震释放约10 TW重力能供给岛弧火山，而正断层地震获得约2 TW。
The specific physical mechanisms and efficiency of converting bulk gravitational energy into localized volcanic heat are not fully resolved.

解决了在被认为是地幔对流低温端的俯冲带发生剧烈火山活动的热力学悖论。

fig.title: Schematic of gravitational energy release and heat conversion at plate boundaries
desc: The figure schematically illustrates the mass transport and gravitational potential energy changes associated with thrust-faulting at subduction zones and normal-faulting at mid-ocean ridges, showing how Eg converts to heat.
该图示意性地展示了与俯冲带逆冲断层和中洋脊正断层相关的物质运移和重力势能变化，展示了重力能如何转化为热能。
interp: This supports the hypothesis that earthquake-induced gravitational energy release is a major heat source for island-arc volcanism, balancing the thermal budget of subduction zones.
这支持了以下假设：地震引起的重力能释放是岛弧火山活动的主要热源，平衡了俯冲带的热收支。
fig.finding: Thrust-faulting earthquakes release a massive amount of gravitational energy (~10 TW) that converts to heat, whereas normal-faulting earthquakes gain energy (~2 TW).
fig.cap: Illustration of the gravitational energy budget (Eg) at subduction zones (thrust faulting releasing ~10 TW) and diverging boundaries (normal faulting gaining ~2 TW).

tm.why: The paper models the gravitational energy release from thrust-faulting and normal-faulting earthquakes.
The study addresses mantle convection energetics and plate tectonics thermodynamics.
It proposes a heat supply mechanism for island-arc volcanism at subduction zones.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public web context discussing the paper's figures and core concepts.

sum: This study utilizes ambient noise interferometry and horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios (HVSR) to monitor the hydrothermal system of Nisyros volcano from 2011 onward. The author observes significant, long-lasting coseismic seismic velocity drops following nearby earthquakes, such as the 2017 Kos earthquake, which are localized beneath the volcanic edifice within two permeable layers in the upper 2 km. In contrast, HVSR peak frequency drops recover quickly, indicating that shallow surface layers are only transiently affected. The persistent velocity drops suggest that dynamic stress changes from passing seismic waves interact with high-pressure hydrothermal fluids, reducing effective stress and promoting fracturing. Additionally, annual velocity fluctuations correlate with precipitation, suggesting unconfined aquifers. The work highlights the high sensitivity of volcanic hydrothermal systems to external stress perturbations.
本研究利用背景噪声干涉测量和HVSR监测尼斯罗斯火山水热系统。发现邻近地震后，火山下方2 km内的渗透层发生持久的波速下降，而表层响应快速恢复。这表明动态应力与高压水热流体相互作用降低了有效应力，加剧介质破裂。此外，年际速度波动与降水负相关，揭示了水热系统对应力扰动的高度敏感性。

t: Ambient noise interferometry and horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios (HVSR) are used to measure temporal seismic velocity variations and shallow site response.
利用背景噪声干涉测量和地动位移振幅比（HVSR）测量地震波速随时间的变化及浅部场地响应。
Continuous seismic waveform data from sparse stations on Nisyros Island from 2011 onward, including regional earthquake records and precipitation data.
2011年起尼斯罗斯岛稀疏台站的连续地震波形数据，包括区域地震记录和降水数据。
Nearby earthquakes induce persistent velocity drops in two permeable layers within the upper 2 km, while seasonal velocity fluctuations are anticorrelated with precipitation.
邻近地震导致火山下方2 km内渗透层发生持久波速下降，且年际速度波动与降水呈负相关。
Sparse seismic station distribution limits the spatial resolution and the ability to constrain deeper hydrothermal structures.

First long-term ambient noise monitoring of Nisyros volcano, revealing its hydrothermal system's high sensitivity to both dynamic earthquake stress and seasonal hydrological loading.
首次对尼斯罗斯火山进行长期背景噪声监测，揭示了其水热系统对地震动态应力和季节性水文载荷的高度敏感性。

sum: This study presents a regional 3-D electrical resistivity model of Mongolia covering 900 x 1250 km^2, incorporating magnetotelluric (MT) data from 378 new stations. Methodologically, it utilizes a scalable, open-source 3-D inverse solver based on the integral equation approach and non-local parametrization. The resulting model reveals an upper crustal dichotomy bounded by the Main Mongolian Lineament and the Ikh-Mongol arc system, lower crustal low-resistivity anomalies bounded by the Mogod fault zone, and an upper-mantle low-resistivity anomaly beneath the Khangai Dome. These findings constrain the lithospheric architecture and geodynamic evolution of the region.
本研究利用378个新增测点的磁共振（MT）数据，构建了覆盖蒙古900×1250平方公里区域的三维电阻率模型。方法上采用了一种基于积分方程法和非局部参数化的新型可扩展开源三维反演求解器。模型揭示了受主要构造边界控制的地壳电阻率分异特征，包括由主要蒙古线裂和Ikh-Mongol弧系统界定的上地壳南北分异……

Magnetotelluric data from 378 new locations acquired between 2020 and 2023, combined with previously acquired datasets across Mongolia.

The spatial coverage, while significantly expanded, may still have gaps that limit the resolution of smaller-scale lithospheric features.

sum: This study investigates the timescales and thermal evolution of magma replenishment in the oceanic upper mantle using chromite nodules from ophiolites. Microstructural observations reveal uniform sizes, monocrystalline textures, and low dihedral angles (~20°), indicating textural equilibrium within basaltic magma. The authors employ a Monte Carlo Potts model to simulate chromite nodule growth via Ostwald ripening. Calibrated with experimental kinetics, the simulations show that these nodules grow over timescales of $10^4$ to $10^6$ years. This implies a long-lived melt flux in the upper mantle with slow cooling rates of $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-4}$ °C/yr. These rates are significantly lower than those in the lower crust, highlighting a sharp contrast in geothermal gradients across the Moho boundary.
本研究利用蛇绿岩中的铬铁矿结核探讨了洋壳上地幔岩浆补给的时间尺度和热演化。微观结构观测显示结核具有均匀粒径、单晶纹理和低二面角（~20°），表明其在玄武质岩浆中达到了结构平衡。研究采用蒙特卡洛Potts模型模拟了通过奥斯特瓦尔德熟化促进的结核生长过程。结合实验动力学标定，结果表明结核形成需10^4至……

t: Monte Carlo Potts modeling calibrated with experimental kinetics to simulate chromite nodule growth via Ostwald ripening in magma conduits.
采用结合实验动力学标定的蒙特卡洛Potts模型，模拟岩浆通道中通过奥斯特瓦尔德熟化进行的铬铁矿结核生长。
Microstructural observations (sizes, textures, dihedral angles) of chromite nodules in ophiolites representing upper mantle magma conduits.
代表上地幔岩浆通道的蛇绿岩中铬铁矿结核的微观结构观测数据（粒径、纹理、二面角）。
Chromite nodules grow over $10^4$–$10^6$ years, indicating prolonged upper mantle melt flux and slow cooling rates of $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-4}$ °C/yr.
铬铁矿结核生长历时10^4至10^6年，表明上地幔存在长期的熔体通量及10^-2至10^-4 °C/yr的极慢冷却速率。
Simplifications in isotropic grain-boundary wettability and reliance on experimental calibration parameters for chromite growth kinetics.
模型简化了各向同性晶界润湿性，且高度依赖于现有的铬铁矿生长动力学实验标定参数。
First quantitative constraint on upper mantle magma replenishment timescales and cooling rates using numerical simulation of chromite nodule ripening.

sum: Lightguide is a Python-based software package designed for processing and modeling seismic Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data. It provides essential routines for data handling, including restitution to apparent velocity or integration to linear strain, alongside frequency and frequency-wavenumber (f-k) filtering. For forward modeling, Lightguide integrates with Pyrocko's Green's function framework, enabling full-waveform modeling of dislocation sources to simulate DAS strain-rate or velocity observations in homogeneous and layered half-spaces. This tool bridges the gap between raw DAS measurements and physical source modeling.
Lightguide是用于分布式声学传感（DAS）数据处理与建模的软件工具包。它提供了数据转换（视速度或线性应变）、频率及f-k滤波等常规算法。在正演方面，该工具包基于Pyrocko格林函数框架，实现了均匀和分层半空间中位错源到DAS观测（应变率/速度）的全波形模拟。该工具为DAS数据处理与震源建模……

sum: This study identifies a new class of monochromatic seismic tremors with a 43 s period in the northern Canadian Arctic using continuous broadband seismic records. Cross-spectral analysis of station pairs reveals that these tremors persist for hours and propagate globally as surface waves. The events occur predominantly during winter, coinciding with 1–4 m thick sea-ice cover. By integrating satellite-derived sea-ice thickness, tremor force spectra, and the dominant period, the authors propose ocean–ice–solid-Earth coupling as the excitation mechanism. This discovery highlights the potential of broadband seismic networks to monitor cryosphere–ocean processes remotely.
本研究利用连续宽频带地震记录，在加拿大北极发现了一种新型43秒周期单频微震。台站对交叉谱分析表明，该微震可持续数小时并作为面波全球传播。微震主要发生在冬季，此时源区覆盖1-4米厚海冰。结合卫星海冰厚度、微震力谱和主周期，研究提出洋-冰-固态地球耦合是其激发机制，展示了地震学监测冰冻圈-海洋过程的潜力……

sum: This study reconstructs the paleo-fluid history of lithospheric-scale faults in the Internal Betics (SE Spain) during tectonic switches from the Eocene to the Pliocene. By combining calcite U/Pb geochronology, stable and clumped isotopes, fluid inclusion microthermometry, and noble gas isotopes (He-Ne-Ar) in quartz and calcite, the authors constrain fluid origins, migration pathways, and fault connectivity. The results reveal variable mixing of meteoric, seawater, brine, crustal, and mantle-sourced fluids. Tectonic switches significantly altered fluid circulation, transitioning from deep-derived, warm systems during extension to meteoric-dominated systems during compression. Noble gas signatures indicate low mantle-sourced contributions (<0.1%), suggesting that while lithospheric faults act as major conduits, mantle fluid input remains limited. This work highlights how tectonic regimes control fault permeability and fluid dynamics.
本研究重建了西班牙南部贝蒂克构造带岩石圈尺度断裂在始新世至上新世构造转换期间的古流体历史。通过结合方解石U/Pb年代学、稳定和团簇同位素、流体包裹体显微测温以及石英和方解石中的惰性气体同位素（He-Ne-Ar），约束了流体来源、运移路径和断裂连通性。结果表明，流体经历了雨水、海水、卤水、地壳和地幔源……

t: Combines calcite U/Pb geochronology, stable and clumped isotopes, fluid inclusion microthermometry, and noble gas isotopes (He-Ne-Ar) in quartz and calcite.

Vein quartz and calcite samples collected from lithospheric-scale faults in the Internal Betics (SE Spain) spanning Eocene to Pliocene tectonic phases.

sum: This study investigates the impact of input noise variability—specifically noise type, scale, and complexity—on the robustness and out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization of neural networks in seismic processing. Focusing on first-break picking and denoising using simulated seismic-while-drilling data, the authors train various neural network architectures under controlled noise conditions generated stochastically. By evaluating models across seen and unseen noise scenarios, they construct a robustness matrix. The results demonstrate that training with larger noise scales enhances generalization, and aligning noise characteristics with task complexity and network architecture is crucial. Furthermore, incorporating compound noise mixtures during training acts as an implicit regularizer, mitigating the limitations of single-noise training and significantly improving model resilience in unpredictable, noisy geophysical environments.
本文研究了输入噪声变率（类型、尺度和复杂度）对地震处理中神经网络鲁棒性及分布外（OOD）泛化能力的影响。针对随钻地震模拟数据中的初至拾取和去噪任务，作者利用随机生成器在受控噪声条件下训练了多种网络架构。通过在已知和未知噪声场景下评估模型，构建了鲁棒性矩阵。结果表明，采用更大尺度的噪声进行训练能显著提……

sum: This paper presents a newly identified mode of axial oscillation, termed the core-mantle gravitational (CMG) mode, which couples Earth's mantle, fluid core, and solid inner core. The mode involves a quasi-rigid rotation of the fluid core outside the tangent cylinder, exchanging angular momentum with the mantle through a three-step process involving magnetic and gravitational torques. This oscillation occurs when the core's magnetic field is strong enough for Alfvén waves to propagate faster than the mode's period. For Earth, the CMG mode period is estimated to be 40 to 100 years, with a low quality factor Q (below 1) if the inner core's viscous relaxation time is under 10 years. The mode may modestly amplify multi-decadal changes in the length of day.
该研究提出了一种新型的核幔重力（CMG）轴向振荡模式，实现了地幔、流体外核和固体内核之间的耦合。该模式涉及切触柱外侧流体核的准刚性旋转，通过磁力矩和重力矩的三步过程与地幔交换角动量。当核内磁场足够强以至于阿尔芬波传播时间短于振荡周期时，就会发生这种重力振荡。对于地球，CMG模式的周期预计在40至10……

Simulated Earth parameters including magnetic field strength, Alfvén wave travel times, and inner core viscous relaxation times.

sum: This study investigates the 2025 Mw 5.4 Xinlong earthquake in the eastern Tibetan Plateau using a multisensor approach combining InSAR, optical correlation, UAV photogrammetry, field mapping, and seismological data. InSAR observations show up to ~7 cm of coseismic line-of-sight deformation and ~4 cm of localized surface displacement discontinuities. Geodetic inversion reveals that normal-faulting slip was concentrated at shallow depths of 1.4–5.7 km, consistent with seismological depth estimates of 5–7 km. The integrated data delineate a shallow rupture zone along a previously unmapped ENE-WSW-trending normal fault. The findings demonstrate the capability of multi-scale, multisensor observations to resolve shallow deformation from moderate earthquakes and highlight active localized extension driven by tectonic extrusion in the eastern Tibetan Plateau.
本研究利用InSAR、无人机航测、野外调查及地震学数据，对2025年藏东新龙Mw 5.4地震进行多源观测。InSAR显示同震形变达~7 cm，破裂带局部不连续达~4 cm。反演表明正断层滑动集中在1.4-5.7 km浅部。多源数据圈定了一条此前未填图的东北东向正断层浅部破裂，揭示了藏东构造挤出背景下……

sum: This study analyzes teleseismic waveforms from the 2022 Hunga submarine eruption to resolve the internal mechanics of its explosive sequence. The authors identify four eruptive episodes characterized by repeating implosion-explosion cycles, separated by three-minute pauses dominated by shear deformation. These cycles suggest an explosive engine driven by a hydraulically isolated, conduit-scale volume much smaller than the main reservoir. This volume is re-pressurized between failures by seawater-driven phreatomagmatic inflow. The findings demonstrate that the recurrence interval of explosive sequences is determined by the repressurization rate of this sealed conduit-scale system, explaining why the eruption paced on a minutes-long scale rather than days. This provides a novel framework for understanding submarine phreatomagmatic eruption dynamics.
本研究利用远震波形分析了2022年汤加海底火山喷发的内部力学机制。发现四个喷发幕呈现出重复的“内爆-爆炸”循环，期间夹杂着以剪切变形为主的3分钟停顿。该循环由通道尺度的微小体积驱动，在喷发间隙通过海水流入进行再加压。爆炸频次取决于该封闭通道系统的加压速率，在分钟尺度上控制了喷发节奏。

sum: This study evaluates on-fault seismicity and probabilistic seismic hazard in New Zealand by comparing a synthetic catalog from the physics-based Rate and State Earthquake Simulator (RSQSim) with the inversion fault model (IFM) from the 2022 New Zealand National Seismic Hazard Model (NZ NSHM 2022). Both models utilize the New Zealand Community Fault Model. The results show that while the IFM simulates larger magnitude ruptures, the RSQSim magnitude-frequency distribution remains within the IFM's uncertainty bounds. Peak ground acceleration discrepancies are generally under 20% in high-seismicity areas but exceed 250% near low-slip-rate faults and the Hikurangi-Kermadec subduction zone. Integrating a distributed seismicity model reduces discrepancies in low-seismicity regions, highlighting the challenges of incorporating physics-based simulators into hazard forecasting.

sum: This study presents a deep learning workflow to estimate focal mechanisms for microseismic events. A combined CNN-Transformer model is trained on Southern California waveforms to predict P-wave polarities and adapted to estimate SH-wave polarities on rotated transverse components. Applied to the Utah FORGE stage 3 stimulation, the model achieves high accuracy (98.0% for P, 96.2% for SH). These polarities, combined with amplitude ratios, are inverted using a double-couple-constrained Bayesian approach, yielding 717 high-quality focal mechanisms that reveal complex strike-slip and normal faulting within the reservoir.

sum: This paper proposes a novel real-time numerical ground motion prediction method for earthquake early warning (EEW) that couples the source and ground motion field. Traditional data-assimilation-based prediction methods often neglect source rupture directivity, leading to limited accuracy. To address this, the authors incorporate a line-source model to dynamically extract rupture directivity and estimate the line-source strike in real time by comparing observed and predicted ground motion fields. Testing on the 2016 Mw 7.0 Kumamoto earthquake shows that the inferred rupture direction within 28 seconds matches post-event inversion results. Correcting for directivity reduces the mean absolute error (MAE) of peak intensity predictions by 16.1%, 5.4%, and 19.6% for lead times of 5s, 10s, and 20s, respectively, demonstrating superior performance over traditional methods.
本文提出耦合震源与地震动场的实时地震预警方法。引入线源模型，通过实时对比观测与预测地震动场动态估计走向并修正破裂直接性。在2016年熊本地震中，震后28秒内推断的破裂方向与事后反演一致，使提前5、10和20秒的峰值烈度预测误差分别降低16.1%、5.4%和19.6%，显著优于传统方法。

sum: This study evaluates the reliability of machine-learning (ML) earthquake catalogs by having four seismologists perform blind verifications on 1,200 detections from six catalogs (including the Ridgecrest sequence). The experts confirmed 60% to 98% of the events they judged, with significant variations (~20 points) between different ML catalogs of the same sequence. To bridge the gap between ML assertions and human endorsement, the authors developed a scoring system based on seven standard catalog parameters. This score successfully reproduces the expert panel's decisions, generalizes to unseen sequences, and ranks machine-only detections lowest, providing a systematic way to integrate human judgment into automated catalogs.

sum: This study presents a refined kinematic model of the Lau Back-Arc Basin's opening from 10 Ma to the present, embedded in a global plate model. The model incorporates three previously unrecognized paleoplates, five microplates, and ten active spreading centers. It highlights how the collision of the Ontong Java Plateau with the Vitiaz arc blocked Pacific Plate subduction, forming a Subduction-Transform Edge Propagator (STEP) fault. Fragmentation and rotation of the Vitiaz arc, along with the reactivation of the Peggy Ridge as a strike-slip fault between 7 and 5 Ma, facilitated back-arc rifting. The findings demonstrate that Lau Basin evolution was highly asymmetric and non-linear, driven not only by slab rollback but also by upper plate processes, including block rotation and fault propagation.
本研究提出了劳后弧盆地自10 Ma至今的改进运动学开裂模型。模型包含3个新古板块、5个微板块和10个活动扩张中心。研究表明，温通爪哇高原碰撞导致俯冲受阻并形成STEP断层；维蒂亚兹弧碎裂旋转及佩吉脊重活化促进了后弧裂谷启动。结果证实劳盆地演化呈高度非线性与不对称性，受板片回撤和上覆板块过程共同驱动。

sum: This study uses 3D thermomechanical numerical experiments coupled with surface processes to investigate the formation of the Eastern Himalayan syntaxis. The authors demonstrate that the syntaxis initially forms during collision when the Eurasian middle-to-lower crust is rheologically weak. As collision progresses, slab flattening and differential plate advance drive the localization of crustal-scale strike-slip faults, dismembering the collision corner. This process facilitates local crustal flow through a narrow channel towards the east and south. The study provides a comprehensive geodynamic framework linking deep slab dynamics with shallow crustal deformation and surface processes to explain the structural and topographic evolution of orogenic syntaxes.

sum: This paper introduces a depth-progressive diffusion framework for seismic velocity model building (VMB) to address the depth-dependent nature of surface-recorded seismic data. Unlike traditional generative models, the proposed method constructs velocity models incrementally from shallow to deep by propagating prior information. It trains on paired shallow-deep velocity patches with variable overlap and explicit depth encoding, incorporating geophysical constraints like well logs and structural reflectivity. During inference, overlapping depth slices are synthesized progressively and merged using Gaussian-weighted blending to eliminate boundary artifacts. Numerical experiments on in-distribution and out-of-distribution synthetic datasets demonstrate high VMB accuracy and a strong correlation between predicted uncertainty and actual errors, validating the framework's effectiveness as a proof of concept.
本文提出一种深度渐进式扩散模型框架，用于自浅入深地增量构建地震速度模型。该方法在具有重叠和深度编码的浅-深速度图像块上进行训练，并融入井测和结构反射率约束。推理时利用渐进式算法合成重叠切片并进行高斯加权融合。数值实验表明，该方法具有高精度的速度模型构建能力，且预测的不确定性与实际误差高度相关。

t: A depth-progressive diffusion framework that trains on paired shallow-deep velocity patches with explicit depth encoding to construct velocity models incrementally.

sum: This study presents a real-time processing framework for offshore Earthquake Early Warning (EEW) using a 300-km-long submarine Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) cable in Central Chile. By adapting established EEW methodologies to DAS data, the authors demonstrate stable location and magnitude predictions within 5 seconds of alert declaration for M4+ events. Testing on 75 days of continuous data showed a 78.6% correct classification rate and a low missed alert rate of 3.8%. False alerts were primarily due to linear network geometry biasing locations of sub-M4 events. This work highlights the potential of submarine DAS to bridge the gap in offshore seismic monitoring and integrate with land-based networks for hybrid EEW systems.
本研究利用智利中部300公里海底分布式声学传感（DAS）光缆，构建了实时海域地震预警（EEW）框架。通过将现有EEW方法应用于DAS，系统在触发后5秒内即可对M4级地震进行稳定定位和震级预测。75天连续数据测试显示，系统正确分类率达78.6%，漏报率仅3.8%。该研究证实了海底DAS进行实时地震预警……

sum: This paper presents an overview of the PRECODE mine-by experiment at BedrettoLab, Switzerland, which investigates brittle fracturing and Excavation Damage Zone (EDZ) evolution in Rotondo Granite. The tunnel was excavated using both drill-and-blast and line-drilling/rock-breaking methods to compare their impacts. By integrating acoustic emission, distributed acoustic and strain sensing, hydraulic monitoring, electrical resistivity tomography, and laboratory testing, the study characterizes short-term EDZ formation and long-term crack growth. Preliminary results reveal significant differences in acoustic emission activity and damage development between the two excavation techniques, while observations from the older Bedretto Tunnel indicate ongoing time-dependent fracturing. This coupled dataset enhances predictive modeling for nuclear waste repositories.

sum: This study investigates the shallow lithospheric structure of the north-central Gulf of California, Mexico, by constructing a 3D S-wave velocity model. Using one year of ambient seismic noise and 11 shallow earthquakes recorded by regional networks (RESBAN, RESNOM, SSN), the authors apply a two-stage surface-wave tomography technique. The resulting model reveals significant lateral velocity variations, crustal thinning (variable Moho depth) in the north, and a more constant Moho depth towards the center. Low-velocity anomalies in the north support the presence of an active geothermal system. The transition from heterogeneous velocity anomalies indicates a lithospheric transition from weak to strong from the central to the northern Gulf, explaining regional tectonic, heat flow, and seismicity patterns.
本研究利用一年的背景地震噪声和11个浅源地震数据，构建了墨西哥加利福尼亚湾中北部地区的三维S波速度模型。研究采用两步面波层析成像技术，获得了高分辨率的绝对速度结构。结果显示该区域地壳和上地幔存在显著的横向变化：北部地壳减薄且莫霍面深度变化大，而中部莫霍面深度相对稳定。北部发现的低速异常证实了地热系统……

sum: This paper investigates the impact of groundwater level variations on seismic ground motion. By modeling the propagation of P- and S-waves through a saturated porous layer overlying an elastic half-space, the authors analyze how fluid saturation affects site response. The results demonstrate that the presence of water alters both the amplitude and resonance frequency of ground motion for both incident wave types. This work highlights the critical need to incorporate fluid saturation and groundwater table fluctuations into seismic site characterization and hazard assessment, providing a theoretical framework for more accurate strong ground motion predictions in hydrologically active areas.

sum: This study analyzes continuous GPS measurements in the Andaman-Nicobar region to search for slow slip events (SSEs) following the 2004 Sumatra-Andaman earthquake. While postseismic deformation continues to decay, the authors identified two unprecedented, large-amplitude, multi-week horizontal displacement transients in 2020 and 2023 at the HBAY site in Little Andaman. These transients are local, recoverable, and unrelated to earthquakes, volcanic activity, hydrological cycles, or ocean tides. Because the deformation is largely recoverable, a tectonic SSE origin is ruled out, confirming the absence of short-term SSEs in this subduction zone and highlighting the presence of non-tectonic local anomalies.

sum: This paper establishes a mathematical bridge between discrete and continuous representations of plate tectonics. By generalizing continuous plate shape functions to a signed-geodesic-distance construction, the author proves a limit theorem showing they converge exponentially to sharp plate indicator functions. The sharp plate mosaic is shown to be a finite regular trivalent CW decomposition of the sphere. The paper introduces a component-counted weighted Euler characteristic that equals 2 below a certain threshold, and defines a topological diffuseness index to quantify diffuse plate boundaries. The theory is validated using the present-day PB2002 plate boundary network.

sum: This paper presents a successful case study of reprocessing legacy 3D multi-block land seismic data from Saudi Arabia. The original data suffered from near-surface statics, multiples, and low fold noise. By applying an advanced workflow featuring tomographic near-surface statics, de-multiple algorithms, and de-aliased noise attenuation, the authors significantly enhanced the subsurface image. Key results include a shift in statics correction range to -80 to -130 ms (compared to -30 to -60 ms previously), a 10 dB boost in frequency bandwidth (25–80 Hz), and a 5-fold improvement in the signal-to-noise ratio. These improvements reduce structural uncertainties and facilitate more reliable hydrocarbon reservoir detection, as validated by post-drilling results.

sum: This paper presents a network-based coherence method, a simple cross-spectral technique applicable to seismic and acoustic networks, to enhance coherent signals and suppress individual sensor noise. It also introduces a phase-based acoustic source localization method using interstation phase differences for non-impulsive signals. The authors demonstrate these methods using data from Mount Spurr, Alaska, where seismic network coherence reveals weak, ephemeral tremor during 2024–2025 unrest, and from the I53US infrasound array, where array coherence identifies monochromatic and frequency-gliding noise, attributing a ~2 Hz signal to a nearby power plant. These methods serve as valuable tools for data quality control, volcano monitoring, and noise assessment.

sum: This paper presents a novel Bayesian ordinal regression framework for disaggregated building damage estimation under tsunami hazards. While traditional tsunami fragility functions link hazard to risk, they often neglect input and output uncertainties. To address this, the authors develop an uncertainty-aware model and train it using building damage data from the 2011 Tohoku Earthquake and Tsunami. Through three distinct case studies, they demonstrate the framework's capacity to handle uncertainties and evaluate its generalization performance and limitations. This work advances probabilistic hazard-to-risk assessment by providing a robust, statistically rigorous tool for coastal vulnerability and mitigation planning.

sum: This study utilizes deep learning and a dense Large-N seismic array to construct an enhanced, high-resolution earthquake catalog for an active saltwater-disposal region in Oklahoma. The authors identify four persistent, low-magnitude (ML = -0.69 to 2.83) seismic clusters near mapped faults. By analyzing local injection histories, they find that wells within 8–10 km exhibit strong short-term temporal correlation with seismicity, independent of injection rate or well distance. The study demonstrates how high-resolution catalogs can capture short-term variations in seismic response that regional networks miss, suggesting that temporal similarity metrics can complement traditional injection-rate and distance criteria for monitoring and mitigating induced seismicity.
本研究利用深度学习和密集台阵构建了俄克拉荷马州废水注入区的高分辨率地震目录。研究识别出四个持续活动的低震级（ML = -0.69 至 2.83）地震群。分析表明，8-10公里范围内的注水井与地震活动具有强烈的短期时间相关性，且该相关性与平均注入速率或距离无关。这表明高分辨率目录能捕捉到区域台网无法解……

sum: This study utilizes controlled-source seismic data from four shoreline-crossing experiments to perform P-wave velocity and Moho tomography across the central Cascadia Subduction Zone (43.6°N to 45.2°N). The resulting model reveals significant structural heterogeneity in the forearc, including variations in backstop geometry, a mafic dike, and low-velocity anomalies along the Alvin Canyon Fault. Notably, the authors identify nine circular high-velocity anomalies at the top of the subducting slab, interpreted as subducting seamounts. These seamounts correlate with localized seismicity, regional uplift, and seafloor landslides. The findings suggest that a highly rugose plate interface, shaped by subducting topography, plays a critical role in reducing plate coupling and acting as a barrier to megathrust rupture propagation in central Cascadia.

sum: This paper presents an automated workflow for 3D near-surface imaging of railway tracks using passing trains as seismic sources. To handle the complex moving source, the method filters cross-correlations based on the angle relative to the train's path, separating cases where the train is near or far from a dense 2D seismic array. Local dispersion curves are extracted from array subsets (patches) using Matched Field Processing. This approach yields broadband Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves extending above 70 Hz, providing high-resolution 3D phase velocity models of the near-surface (down to ~1 m depth). The method successfully images variations in the ballast layer, demonstrating its utility for monitoring critical railway infrastructure.

sum: This study develops a multi-region deep learning framework based on a modified U-Net architecture to detect low-frequency earthquakes (LFEs). Trained on a curated dataset from six tectonic environments, the model uses probabilistic Gaussian labels and multi-station waveform inputs to handle low signal-to-noise ratios and emergent onsets. Applied to continuous ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data in the Guerrero seismic gap, Mexico, the workflow successfully recovered 21 cataloged events and identified 25 new offshore LFE candidates. These detections exhibit temporal clustering and spatial distributions distinct from existing catalogs, demonstrating that deep learning can effectively complement matched-filter methods in data-sparse or template-limited offshore regions.

sum: This paper introduces joint twist-flow, an augmented flow-matching formulation designed for Bayesian inverse problems. Standard conditional generative models often suffer from mode collapse or under-representation of posterior uncertainty. Joint twist-flow addresses this by learning a continuous transport between augmented source and terminal states, incorporating a Gaussian likelihood-side coordinate associated with the observation residual. This coupling reduces likelihood-inconsistent variations while preserving posterior variability in weakly constrained directions. The method is validated on low-dimensional multimodal problems, image restoration, and seismic subsurface velocity-model inversion, demonstrating superior posterior coverage and observation consistency compared to direct conditional-flow baselines.

sum: This study compiles paleoseismic data from 20 active fault segments in Yunnan, China, to characterize major earthquake recurrence patterns and estimate time-dependent probabilities. By fitting the data to four renewal models (including Weibull and lognormal), the authors calculate the probability of a major earthquake occurring within the next 30 years. They find that approximately half of the segments exhibit quasi-periodic recurrence, with the Weibull model providing the best fit overall. Five segments are identified as having relatively high earthquake probabilities, corresponding to earlier expected next-event times. The study provides a long-timescale baseline for seismic hazard assessment in Yunnan, though it operates under simplified assumptions that exclude multisegment ruptures and stress interactions.

sum: This study investigates the temporal gap between the initiation of subduction and the subsequent onset of arc volcanism using advanced two-phase flow numerical modeling. By simulating the coupled dynamics of solid rock deformation and melt migration, the authors explore how various parameters, such as subduction velocity, slab dip angle, and volatile content, control the time lag. The modeling results provide quantitative constraints on the transport rates of fluids and melts from the dehydrating slab to the overriding crust, shedding light on the early-stage evolution of subduction zones and the mechanisms triggering initial arc magmatism.

sum: This paper presents an unsupervised deep learning framework for five-dimensional (5D) seismic data reconstruction. The method integrates implicit neural representation (INR) with a Transformer backbone and short-time Fourier transform (STFT) based time-frequency feature learning. By parameterizing the seismic wavefield as a continuous mapping from 4D spatial coordinates to amplitudes, and using a novel 4D positional encoding scheme, the model captures global long-range dependencies and high-dimensional spatial structures. It predicts real and imaginary components of the time-frequency spectrum, reconstructing waveforms via inverse STFT. Tested on synthetic and field 5D datasets, the proposed method outperforms conventional methods (POCS, damped rank reduction) and baseline INR approaches in recovering amplitude, phase, and azimuthal anisotropy without requiring labeled training data.

sum: This study analyzes the temporal and spatial characteristics of slow slip events (SSEs) in the Costa Rica subduction zone to understand how they are modulated throughout the megathrust earthquake cycle. By examining geodetic observations, the paper sheds light on the interaction between slow slip and seismic cycles, providing key insights into fault mechanics, frictional properties, and stress evolution along subduction interfaces.

sum: The authors present the Global Long-wavelength Body-wave Catalog (GLoBoCat), containing millions of P and S wave travel-time measurements for the lower mantle from 2010 to 2023. To overcome the scalability limits of manual picking, they employ an attention-based machine learning model trained on existing high-consistency manual datasets. GLoBoCat significantly improves raypath coverage, particularly in the southern hemisphere. Comparing these long-period measurements with short-period travel times reveals a discrepancy in correlation between early and late arrivals, which is more pronounced in P waves than S waves. This observed slope change, opposite to predicted wave propagation effects, suggests potential physical dispersion in the lower mantle. The study provides a highly consistent, easily updatable dataset for deep Earth imaging.

sum: This study analyzes the 2 May 2025 Mw 7.4 Drake Passage earthquake, which occurred at the complex tectonic transition between the Shackleton Fracture Zone and the Chilean Trench. By utilizing global and regional seismic waveforms, the study constrains the earthquake's focal mechanism, depth, and rupture process. The results provide critical insights into how oceanic fracture zones accommodate relative plate motion and interact with subduction zones in remote, high-latitude marine environments. This event sheds light on the active stress state and deformation style of the Scotia-Antarctic-Nazca plate boundary.

sum: This study investigates Neogene-Quaternary intraplate basaltic magmatism across the Western Mediterranean Region to reconstruct past mantle thermal structure and dynamic topography. By combining major, trace, and rare earth element (REE) inverse modeling from six volcanic provinces with calibrated earthquake tomographic models and residual topography measurements, the authors show that melting occurred beneath a 60–70 km thick lithosphere. Asthenospheric potential temperatures range from ambient to 50°C above ambient. These geochemical estimates show excellent agreement with independent seismic tomography constraints. The calculated dynamic support matches measured residual anomalies, demonstrating that lithospheric thinning, rather than large asthenospheric temperature anomalies, drives the largest positive topographic anomalies (~0.5 km). This confirms that dated intraplate basalts reliably record upper-mantle thermal conditions and transient dynamic topography.
本研究结合西地中海板内玄武岩的稀土元素反演模拟、地震层析成像与残余地形测量，重建了该区域上地幔热结构。结果表明，熔融发生于60-70 km厚的岩石圈下，软流圈潜温较常温高0-50°C，与层析成像一致。岩石圈变薄解释了约0.5 km的最大正地形异常，证实了板内玄武岩可用于重建历史动力地形。

sum: This study analyzes 6,409 high-resolution shear-wave splitting (SWS) measurements from 465 broadband seismic stations to investigate seismic azimuthal anisotropy across the northeastern Tibetan Plateau and western North China Craton. The results reveal a complex double-layer horizontal anisotropy structure in the central study area. The upper layer's anisotropy is attributed to ductile flow in the middle-to-lower crust that bifurcates around the rigid Alxa Block. The lower layer's anisotropy, with NW-SE fast orientations, aligns with the absolute plate motion of the Eurasian plate. Spatial coherence analysis suggests that asthenospheric flow, modulated by the Ordos and Sichuan cratonic keels, is the dominant source of anisotropy. This work provides critical observational constraints on the lithosphere-asthenosphere coupling and deformation mechanisms in a major tectonic transition zone.

sum: This study applies a recently developed time-domain extended-source full-waveform inversion (ES-FWI) to long-offset ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data from the eastern Nankai subduction zone, Japan, to overcome the cycle-skipping challenge. ES-FWI reconstructs wavefields using extended sources (combining experimental and scattering sources) and updates the velocity model by minimizing these scattering sources. Starting from a first-arrival traveltime tomography model, the multiscale ES-FWI workflow, followed by classical FWI refinement, successfully reconstructs high-resolution crustal structures. The final model resolves key features such as the subduction megathrust and the overlying décollement, demonstrating the effectiveness of ES-FWI in mitigating nonlinearity in long-offset seismic imaging.
本文将新开发的时域扩展源全波形反演（ES-FWI）应用于日本南海海槽东部的长偏移距海底地震仪（OBS）数据，以解决周期跳跃问题。ES-FWI利用包含实验源和散射源的扩展源重构波场，并通过最小化散射源来更新速度模型。该方法以初至旅行时断层成像模型为起点，采用多尺度工作流，并结合经典FWI进行后期精细化……

sum: This study utilizes a newly compiled high-resolution marine magnetic anomaly map and 2D forward modeling to investigate the tectonic evolution of the southeastern East Sea (Japan Sea). The authors identify coherent ENE-WSW trending magnetic lineations (Chron C6An.1n–C5Dn) in the Ulleung Basin, constraining its seafloor spreading to 20–17 Ma with a half-rate of 20 km/Myr. Crucially, they demonstrate that the western basin margin, the East Korean Fracture Zone (a fossil transform boundary), spatially coincides with the modern Ulleung Major Thrust. This provides direct geophysical evidence of transform-to-thrust reactivation driven by E-W compressional stress, offering key insights into how lithospheric weaknesses control tectonic inversion in back-arc systems.

sum: This study demonstrates the feasibility of using submarine telecommunication cables for direct tsunami wavefield sensing. By leveraging fiber-optic sensing technologies on existing seafloor infrastructure, the authors show that tsunami waves can be detected in real-time as they propagate across the ocean. This direct wavefield sensing capability enables timely and accurate forecasting of coastal wave heights, significantly improving early warning systems for tsunami hazards. The novelty lies in repurposing global submarine telecom networks as a dense, ocean-bottom sensor array for real-time hazard mitigation without requiring dedicated seafloor instruments.

sum: This paper addresses a critical issue in statistical seismology: the comparison of new earthquake forecasting models against weak or 'under-implemented' Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) benchmarks. To ensure that improvements claimed by new models are scientifically interpretable and genuine, the author proposes the POGA (Parity of information, Optimization, Generality, and Assessment) test. This framework provides a systematic way to evaluate model comparisons, ensuring that the benchmark model is fully optimized and has access to the same information, thereby making model advancements truly meaningful.

sum: This study evaluates the validity of using a static arrest criterion to predict earthquake rupture limits by comparing static arrest lengths with fully dynamic rupture simulations. Using 60 antiplane and 60 in-plane rupture cases on a 120 km fault with linear slip weakening, the author tests whether ruptures stop where the static energy release rate falls below the fracture energy. The results show that in 22 of the 120 cases, the static criterion incorrectly predicted arrest for ruptures that actually spanned the entire fault dynamically. Furthermore, when both models predicted arrest, the dynamic rupture length was consistently longer than the static prediction. This work demonstrates that dynamic effects are crucial for determining whether a rupture can span a fault, suggesting that static-based population models may underestimate the occurrence of large, fault-spanning earthquakes.

sum: This paper presents a data simulating-processing-migration workflow to image shallow crustal structures in volcanic regions using local earthquake synthetic records, using the Campi Flegrei caldera as a reference. By simulating 400 micro-earthquakes (1–3 km depth) in a vertically layered velocity model, the authors construct 2D seismic sections sorted by source-receiver distance to identify seismic phases. They apply a modified Kirchhoff migration technique integrated with Shifted Total Variation (STV) regularization and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). This approach effectively suppresses migration artifacts, enhances coherent events, and provides robust reconstruction of subsurface interfaces under noise and model perturbations. The novelty lies in treating passive local earthquake data like active-source data for high-resolution shallow discontinuity imaging with advanced regularization.

sum: This study introduces the Basin Sloshing Index (BSI), a novel dimensionless parameter defined as BSI = 2*pi*Q*(L/lambda), to provide a unified physical explanation for long-period ground motion and prolonged shaking in large sedimentary basins. Drawing an analogy from fluid sloshing dynamics, the author applies BSI to the Kanto Basin (BSI ~ 12,500), demonstrating how high inertial dominance explains key features like 5–10 s amplification, double peaks, and long-duration shaking. The study also suggests that dynamic flattening from repeated large earthquakes has maintained the Kanto Basin's flat geomorphology over geological timescales. Furthermore, the framework connects basin-scale resonance to whole-Earth free oscillations (BSI ~ 2,500), placing them on a single dimensionless 'worldline' and offering an intuitive, fluid-like perspective on long-period solid Earth dynamics.
本研究引入了新型无量纲参数“盆地晃动指数”（BSI = 2πQ(L/λ)），为大型沉积盆地中的长周期地面运动和持续震动提供了统一的物理学解释。借鉴流体晃动动力学，作者计算出关东盆地的BSI约为12,500，表明其具有极高的惯性主导性，从而合理解释了5-10秒频段放大、双峰效应及超100秒的持续震动。……

sum: This study investigates the 2025 M7.8 Mandalay earthquake along the Sagaing Fault by combining remote sensing observations and 3D dynamic rupture modeling. The authors reveal a helix-shaped fault geometry from along-strike variations in coseismic and interseismic deformation. They find that the average coseismic slip matches or exceeds the interseismic slip deficit, supporting a minimally slip-predictable model. By generating an ensemble of dynamic rupture models constrained by static slip and validating them against geodetic, seismic, and video data, they identify a preferred scenario featuring bilateral initiation transitioning to unilateral southward supershear propagation at depth, while shallow rupture remains subshear. This demonstrates how pre-event observations can anticipate complex rupture dynamics on mature faults.

sum: This study presents the first comprehensive geophysical investigation of Amorgos Island, Greece, to understand why it suffered unexpectedly low damage during the devastating 1956 Ms 7.4 earthquake doublet compared to nearby Santorini. Using Ambient Vibration Arrays (AVAs) and Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW), alongside seismic data from a 2025 earthquake sequence, the authors characterized the island's near-surface velocity structure. They found moderate-to-high shear- and compressional-wave velocities indicating stiff soil conditions and a lack of site amplification. Furthermore, seismological data revealed short-duration ground motions and strong attenuation of high-frequency energy (>6 Hz), which matches the resonant frequencies of traditional Cycladic buildings. These findings suggest that Amorgos's geological setting mitigated earthquake impacts, though spatial variations in macroseismic intensities remain unexplained.
本研究对希腊阿莫尔戈斯岛进行首次地球物理调查，解释其在1956年Ms 7.4大地震中受灾较轻的原因。利用台阵微动和面波分析，结合2025年地震数据，发现该岛地层坚硬，无场地放大效应。此外，地震动具有短持续时间和显著的高频（>6 Hz）衰减，避开了传统建筑的共振频率，表明地质条件减轻了地震灾害。

sum: This paper presents a new methodology for regional probabilistic seismic hazard analysis (PSHA) to determine the probability of ground shaking exceeding a threshold anywhere within a region, rather than at a single site. The authors benchmark stochastic sampling algorithms, compare spatial covariance models (including a new model based on dense observations of the 2019 Ridgecrest aftershocks), and determine optimal spatial discretization. They apply this method to California's San Francisco Bay Area, calculating the probability of peak ground acceleration exceeding 0.1g to 0.8g over 1- to 30-year timescales. The study highlights the impacts of short-term versus long-term earthquake rates, ground motion variability, and source selection on regional hazard estimates.

sum: This study estimates residual topography across global back-arc basins by correcting bathymetry for sediment loading, crustal structure, and lithospheric age. The authors find that most back-arc basins exhibit negative residual topography, which correlates with slab dip (becoming more negative with steeper dips). Continental-oceanic back-arc systems show more pronounced negative anomalies than ocean-ocean systems. Additionally, residual topography covaries with cumulative subducted water content, pointing to the potential role of hydration-modified mantle rheology in modulating slab-driven flow. These findings provide important observational constraints on mantle flow and dynamic topography in subduction zones.

sum: This study investigates the long-term thermal and physical evolution of cratons and its link to kimberlite magmatism. Using 27 two-dimensional numerical models of craton evolution in a convecting mantle, the authors explore how initial thickness, compositional buoyancy, radiogenic heating, and mantle cooling affect cratonic lithosphere. The models show that while Archean cratons initially thinned due to gravitational flattening, progressive mantle cooling increased craton viscosity and density, driving gradual thickening after 2000 Ma. This slow thickening eventually brought cratons into the 160–250 km 'kimberlite window' where kimberlites are generated. This mechanism explains the observed global increase in kimberlite eruption frequency after 1500 Ma, demonstrating that craton thickening processes (compression and cooling) outpace thinning processes (sub-lithospheric dripping) over geological timescales.
本研究探讨了克拉通的长期热演化及其与金伯利岩岩浆作用的联系。通过27个地幔对流中克拉通演化的二维数值模型，研究了初始厚度、化学浮力、放射性生热和地幔冷却的影响。结果表明，尽管太古代克拉通因重力平铺而变薄，但随着地幔冷却，克拉通粘度和密度增加，使其在约20亿年前开始缓慢增厚。这种缓慢增厚使克拉通进入了……

sum: This paper presents a four-step workflow to convert static TensorFlow/Keras deep-learning seismic phase pickers to PyTorch without retraining, enabling seamless integration into the SeisBench library. The workflow consists of architectural alignment, weight extraction/layout transformation, explicit parameter mapping, and staged validation. The authors demonstrate this by converting the Earthquake Compact Convolutional Transformer (EQCCT), a production phase picker used by the Texas Seismological Network (TexNet). Validation on 100,000 STEAD and TXED waveform windows shows that the converted PyTorch models (EQCCTP and EQCCTS) achieve near-identical numerical behavior to the original TensorFlow models, with mean absolute errors between 1.46e-9 and 1.82e-9 and identical detection decisions. This workflow provides a reliable reference for porting other TensorFlow-based seismic models to PyTorch while preserving their operational characteristics.
本文提出了一种无需重新训练即可将TensorFlow/Keras深度学习震相拾取器转换为PyTorch的四步工作流，以便集成到SeisBench库中。该工作流包括架构对齐、权重提取与布局转换、显式参数映射以及分阶段验证。作者通过转换德克萨斯地震台网（TexNet）使用的EQCCT模型验证了该方法。在……

sum: This study explores how Earth's rapid rotation and subsequent deceleration due to the Moon's tidal recession shaped early Earth tectonics. Using planetary structure and tidal evolution calculations, the author demonstrates that Earth's changing shape drove significant latitudinal variations in crustal thickness, polar extension, and equatorial convergence. These tectonic motions could have facilitated the burial of hydrated surface materials, extensive volcanism, and mantle delamination, explaining the rapid emergence of diverse rock types and early mantle heterogeneities within tens of millions of years of Earth's formation.
本研究探讨了月球潮汐退行引起的地球自转减速如何塑造早期地球的构造运动。作者利用行星结构和潮汐演化计算，表明地球形状的变化导致了显著的纬度地壳厚度差异、极区张裂和赤道汇聚。这些构造运动可能促进了含水地表物质的埋藏、广泛的火山活动以及地壳拆沉，从而解释了地球形成后数千万年内多样化岩石类型的出现和早期地幔……

t: Planetary structure and tidal evolution calculations modeling Earth's shape and rotational deceleration.
模拟地球形状和自转减速的行星结构与潮汐演化计算。

撞击后早期地月系统的理论参数。

sum: This paper evaluates the Foreshock Traffic Light System (FTLS) using a real-time test on the Kumamoto earthquake sequence. The FTLS is designed to assess in real-time whether an ongoing earthquake sequence is likely to lead to a larger event (foreshock behavior) or decay (aftershock behavior) based on spatial and temporal variations in the seismic b-value. By applying this system to the Kumamoto sequence, the authors test the operational feasibility and predictive power of the b-value traffic light methodology under real-time conditions, providing critical insights into operational earthquake forecasting and seismic hazard mitigation.
本文利用熊本地震序列对前震红绿灯系统（FTLS）进行了实时测试。FTLS旨在根据地震b值的时空变化，实时评估当前地震序列是可能引发更大地震（前震行为）还是逐渐衰减（余震行为）。通过将该系统应用于熊本地震序列，作者测试了b值红绿灯方法在实时条件下的操作可行性和预测能力，为地震危险性分析和实时地震预报提……

t: The study utilizes the Foreshock Traffic Light System (FTLS) to monitor real-time changes in the seismic b-value, which acts as a proxy for stress state to distinguish foreshocks from aftershocks.

The method is tested using real-time or simulated real-time seismic catalog data from the Kumamoto earthquake sequence.

sum: This study presents a hierarchical paired comparison of 8kg hammer and gun acquisition protocols for active Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW) using 13 matched source positions. Individual and stacked gathers were processed using phase-shift imaging, automated ridge extraction, and manual verification. The results show that while the hammer provides slightly more relative low-frequency energy (4.5–10 Hz) and the gun stack yields a marginally longer maximum wavelength, both sources produce overlapping shear-wave velocity intervals across all inverted layers. The study demonstrates that source ranking is highly endpoint- and threshold-dependent, and introduces an individual-to-stack consistency framework to improve the reliability of MASW interpretations.
本研究在主动源多道瞬态面波勘探（MASW）中，对8kg铁锤和枪源采集方案进行了13个配对震源位置的对比。通过相移成像、自动脊线提取和人工验证对26个SEG-2数据记录进行处理和反演。结果表明，尽管铁锤提供了略多的低频能量（4.5-10 Hz），而枪源叠加提供了略长的最大波长，但两者反演得到的剪切波速……

t: Active MASW processing using phase-shift imaging, automated ridge extraction, manual verification, and source-composite stacking (trace and image stacking) followed by fixed-layer conditional inversion.
基于相移成像、自动脊线提取、人工验证及震源叠加的主动源MASW处理与反演方法。
26 SEG-2 gathers from 13 matched source positions comparing an 8kg hammer and a gun source with a 12-receiver array.
在13个配对位置采集的26个SEG-2地震记录，对比了8kg铁锤与枪源。
Both sources yielded overlapping shear-wave velocity intervals (differences of -17.6 to +14.1 m/s, all 95% intervals including zero), showing no distinct velocity structure or depth advantage.
两种震源反演的剪切波速度区间高度重合，未表现出明显的探测深度或速度结构差异。
Findings are limited to the specific site conditions, 12-receiver array geometry, and the two specific active sources tested.
研究结果受限于特定的场地条件、12道检波器排列几何及所对比的两种震源。
First hierarchical paired comparison of hammer and gun MASW protocols using an individual-to-stack consistency framework and rigorous statistical bootstrap testing.
首次提出“单记录-叠加”一致性框架，并对MASW震源进行了严格的配对统计对比。
